thought.title: TBuf Direct Copy + ReduceSum Vectorization
thought.description: Replaced TQue (AllocTensor/EnQue/DeQue/FreeTensor per row) with TBuf+DataCopy for input/output. Added ReduceSum for vectorized sum-of-squares. Eliminated ~49K TQue calls for 4096 rows.
thought.reason: TQue per-row overhead dominates: each row requires 3× AllocTensor + 3× EnQue + 3× DeQue + 3× FreeTensor. TBuf+DataCopy eliminates all TQue overhead, and ReduceSum vectorizes the scalar reduction.
